cookies-policy-intro: This Cookie Policy clarifies the nature of Cookies and their application by Us. It is important for You to review this policy in order to comprehend the kinds of cookies We utilize, the data We gather through Cookies, and how that data is employed. Typically, Cookies do not encompass any details that can personally recognize a user. However, the personal data We maintain about You might be connected to the information preserved in and acquired from Cookies. For additional details on Our practices for using, storing, and safeguarding your personal information, please consult our Privacy Policy. We refrain from preserving sensitive personal data, such as postal addresses, account passwords, and so on, in the Cookies We employ.
interpretation-text: Terms with the initial letter capitalized possess definitions outlined under the specified conditions. These definitions maintain the same meaning irrespective of their appearance in singular or plural forms.
definitions-intro: In the context of this Cookie Policy:
definition-company: Company (also referred to as "the Company," "We," "Us," or "Our" in this Cookie Policy) pertains to the TermsFeed.com website.
definition-cookies: Cookies are small files placed on Your computer, mobile device, or any other device by a website, which contain information about your browsing history on that website, among other purposes.
definition-you: You signifies the individual accessing or using the Website, a company, or any legal entity for which such an individual is accessing or using the Website, as applicable.
categories-of-cookies-text: Cookies can be classified as "Persistent" or "Session" Cookies. Persistent Cookies remain on your personal computer or mobile device after you go offline, whereas Session Cookies are eliminated as soon as you close your web browser. We utilize both session and persistent Cookies for the objectives outlined below:
necessary-cookies-purpose: Purpose: These Cookies are crucial for offering You services accessible through the Website and allowing You to use some of its functions. They aid in authenticating users and preventing fraudulent use of user accounts. Without these Cookies, the services You request cannot be delivered, and We exclusively use these Cookies to supply You with those services.
cookies-notice-acceptance-purpose: Purpose: These Cookies determine whether users have accepted the utilization of cookies on the Website.
functionality-cookies-purpose: Purpose: These Cookies enable us to recall choices You make while using the Website, such as remembering your login information or language preference. The aim of these Cookies is to offer You a more personalized experience and to prevent You from having to re-enter your preferences each time You use the Website.
tracking-cookies-purpose: Purpose: These Cookies are employed to gather information about traffic to the Website and how users engage with the Website. The data acquired via these Cookies may directly or indirectly identify you as a unique visitor. This is because the collected information is usually linked to a pseudonymous identifier associated with the device you use to access the Website. We might also use these Cookies to test new advertisements, pages, features, or new functionality of the Website to assess how our users respond to them. We ensure that any third-party cookies comply with applicable data protection regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
your-options-text: If You prefer not to use Cookies on the Website, first, You must deactivate the use of Cookies in your browser and then erase the Cookies saved in your browser linked to this website. You may use this alternative to prevent the use of Cookies at any time. If You decline Our Cookies, You might encounter some inconvenience while using the Website, and certain features may not operate correctly. If You wish to remove Cookies or instruct your web browser to delete or refuse Cookies, kindly visit the help pages of your web browser. Additionally, you have the right to withdraw your consent for the use of Cookies at any time, as required by GDPR:
chrome-browser: Chrome: For the Chrome web browser, please visit this Google page: https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050
ie-browser: IE: For the Internet Explorer web browser, please visit this Microsoft page: http://support.microsoft.com/kb/278835
firefox-browser: Firefox: For the Firefox web browser, please visit this Mozilla page: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/delete-cookies-remove-info-websites-stored
safari-browser: Safari: For the Safari web browser, please visit this Apple page: https://support.apple.com/guide/safari/manage-cookies-and-website-data-sfri11471/mac
other-browsers: Other: For any other web browser, please refer to your web browser's official web pages.
contact-us-text: If you have any inquiries about this Cookie Policy, You can reach out to us: By visiting this page on our website.
